Acme Corporation Employee Handbook. Employees are entitled to twenty days of paid vacation per year. Remote work is permitted up to three days per week. All confidential client information must be encrypted at rest and in transit. Violations of the data protection policy may result in termination. Acme Corporation Employee Handbook.
